notes.v1_01: Toaster: Make the chrome a soft satin with one broad highlight down the left of the front and a slightly darker right side, in place of the mirror reflections. Tint the floor under the toaster to the same mid pink as the wall, with no white hotspot. Keep the toast, the red knob and the lever.
notes.v1_02: Cutting Board: Make the tablecloth a soft pale blue with faint, low-contrast light blue checks, with no pure white squares and no weave texture. Bring the camera slightly closer so the board fills more of the card. Make the board's wood smooth with a few faint wide grain lines, and keep the tomato, cucumber and carrot slices.
notes.v1_03: Cooking Pot: Remove the water droplets from the lid and pot, and give the teal enamel one soft broad highlight. Keep the flame glow small and right under the pot, and make the stovetop a slightly lighter neutral dark grey with no orange spill. Keep the tiles, the steam and the handles.
